title: Retain incoming delta candidates through the explicit exchange step
outcome: Retain incoming delta candidates through the explicit exchange step
acceptance: The CLI/shared-service exchange step surface provides an explicit attributed way to derive and retain an incoming delta candidate from the exact selected retained Git commits under the existing custody reservation, so apply_delta is reachable without private helpers.

The operation validates binding, direction, profile, source commits, actor, origin and exact retry identity without fetching, pushing or manufacturing native authority; retained payload and original IDs remain exact.

A real two-clone incoming workflow uses the public step instead of private retain_candidate, then successfully applies and replays the delta with expected native planning effects and refusal/state preservation on changed inputs.
